findings.risk: If populated, the public repository/site exposes unsalted deterministic SHA-256 hashes of customer email addresses. Email addresses have a constrained search space, so an attacker can dictionary/hash common addresses and infer membership. A hash is not anonymization in this design.
findings.current_exposure: NONE_OBSERVED_AT_CAPTURE; current public JSON has zero entries.
findings.product_dependency: The public signals page uses this list for client-side subscriber membership verification. Removing the list without a replacement would break the current gate.
findings.remediation: Move membership verification to an authenticated server-side endpoint using a secret-keyed HMAC or payment-provider verification. Never ship the key or a subscriber-hash list to the browser. Rate-limit and minimize logs; publish only aggregate counts if needed.
findings.decision: NO_CODE_CHANGE_IN_THIS_PR. A secure endpoint host, secret storage and product behavior decision are not established. Do not disable the workflow or membership gate without a reviewed replacement.

next_action: Design and test a server-side subscriber verification endpoint or a provider-signed verification flow before changing subscriber_sync or web/signals.html.
